targetWords.definition: An academy is a special type of school.
targetWords.example: ■There are many courses taught at the academy that I go to.

targetWords.definition: in /a n t] adj. If something is ancient, it is very old.
targetWords.example: I want to see the ancient buildings in Rome.

targetWords.definition: A board is a flat piece of wood.
targetWords.example: The sign was made of a few wooden boards.

targetWords.definition: A century is one hundred years.
targetWords.example: Our company is celebrating a century of business in London.

targetWords.definition: A clue is a fact or object that helps solve a mystery or crime.
targetWords.example: The detective found some clues on the sidewalk.

targetWords.definition: —' I enjoyed the concert last night. The band was very good.
A county is the largest political division of a state in the US.
targetWords.example: He wanted to represent the citizens of his county.

targetWords.definition: A dictionary is a book that tells you what words mean.
targetWords.example: I use the dictionary to learn new words.

targetWords.definition: To exist is to be real.
targetWords.example: Do you really think that unicorns ever existed?

targetWords.definition: Flat describes something that is level and smooth with no curved parts
targetWords.example: My parents bought a new flat screen TV over the weekend.

targetWords.definition: A gentleman is a nice man.
targetWords.example: My grandfather is a kind and helpful gentleman.

targetWords.definition: Hidden means to be not easily noticed or too hard to find.
targetWords.example: The hidden camera recorded everything in the parking lot.

targetWords.definition: Maybe is used to show that something is possible or may be true.
targetWords.example: ■If I focus hard enough, maybe I can come up with the right answer.

targetWords.definition: An officer is a leader in the army.
targetWords.example: The soldiers followed the orders of the officer.

targetWords.definition: If something is original, it is the first one of that thing.
targetWords.example: This is the original painting of the Mona Lisa.

targetWords.definition: To pound something is to hit it many times with a lot of force.
targetWords.example: He pounded the nail with the hammer.

targetWords.definition: A process is the steps to take to do something.
targetWords.example: Making a cake is a long process.

targetWords.definition: To publish a book is to get it printed and ready to sell.
A theater is a building where you watch plays, shows, and movies.
targetWords.example: We went to the theater to see a play.

targetWords.definition: Wealth is a large amount of money.
targetWords.example: One of the most important things to some people is wealth. -

story.title: Adams County's Gold
story.passage:
Adams Academy was a good school. Boys lived there and took classes. Tom

worked hard all week. On a spring Saturday, he wanted to do something fun!

He asked his friend Jeff to go to the movie theater. " Sorry," Jeff answered. " I'm

going to a concert."

So Tom asked Joe to go to the movies. But Joe's soccer team had a game.

Next, Tom went down the hall to Brad's room. Brad was reading a very large

old book. " Hi, Brad," Tom said. "Are you reading a dictionary? It looks ancient."

" No. This is called The Wealth of Adams County. It's about hidden gold in

Adams County. It's more than a century old. It was published in 1870 ! Look, it

even has the original cover on it."

Tom asked, "Where did you get it?"

" It's from my dad's friend. He is a nice gentleman, an officer in the army,"

answered Brad.

"The gold doesn't really exist, does it?" Tom asked.

" I don't know, but maybe! There are clues to it in this book. Let's find it!"

Looking for gold sounded like fun.

The first clue was to find a flat tree underground. " It must be in the forest,"

Tom said.

Brad said, "The flat tree could be a board under the dirt. It could cover the

gold."

Tom and Brad dug in the dirt all morning.

The process of looking for gold made them

hungry. They were ready to stop for lunch.

But then Brad hit something hard. It was a

board!

Brad pounded on the board until it broke.

There was a small hole under it. " Look!" He

held up a gold coin.

Tom saw a piece of paper in the hole. " Brad,

there's more. It's a map to the rest of the

gold!"

Brad smiled. " Let's go!" And they

hurried to find the wealth of Adams

County.
